Hi Nina,

Thanks for the detailed request and the signed authorization — received. I'm escalating this as a targeted removal request and creating an internal support case (RQ-ORCA-217) to track the work.

Next steps / what we need from you to proceed:
- Confirm the exact message timestamp range (if you have a specific thread start/end time). If you don't, our engineering team will use the identifiers in your PDF to locate the conversation.
- Confirm whether removal should include derived telemetry (e.g., aggregated analytics rows) or only raw conversation bodies and audit traces.

Our process overview:
1) Privacy intake & validation (today)
2) Engineering identification and scoped excision from logs (1-3 business days after validation)
3) Internal QA and forward-looking retention marker (ensures not re-ingested)
4) Delivery of a short removal report containing an internal removal id and timestamp window.

I'll coordinate with Marissa and Connor for the engineering work. We may ask for a short POA (proof of authority) if the legal sig doesn't match the account admin on file.

I'll update you by end of day tomorrow with an ETA.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Privacy & Trust, Redwood Inference
